pages.title: Two-handed firepower
pages.text: The Energy Lance is a longer relative of the Energy Sabre. Right-click to fire a laser like those used by Combat Drones.$(br2)Keep your off hand completely empty. A shield, torch or any other item prevents firing.$(br2)A laser deals 30% more raw damage than a fully charged ordinary sabre hit. It fires once per second and uses one durability per shot, without ammunition. Upgrade modules use the same fuel system as an Enhanced Energy Sabre.

pages.title: Configure with 0
pages.text: Hold the lance in your main hand and press the armor configuration key, normally $(thing)0$(). Select the lance to install, remove and toggle modules, assign hotkey groups and load both fuel dusts.$(br2)Supports $(item)Energy Efficiency$(), $(item)Autofeed$(), $(item)Power$(), $(item)Inhibit$(), $(item)Looting$() and $(item)Fire$().$(br2)Power boosts laser damage; Inhibit removes beneficial effects and suppresses Master Soldier regeneration. Looting and Fire apply to laser hits. An occupied off hand also stops the modules.

pages.title: Obtain a lance
pages.text: Use the matching Energy Lance blueprint in a Constructor or Auto Constructor. The blueprint is reusable.$(br2)Materials: Energy Sabre, Advanced Circuit, 10 Silver Ingots, 5 Negarite Dust, 5 Posirite Dust, 2 Platinum Ingots and 2 Lithium Ingots.$(br2)With ArienteWorld installed, lances and their blueprints are rare Storage Cube loot. Some soldiers and guards carry them: use cover against their ranged fire.
